title: Law to reform the Third Party Transfer property foreclosure program
summary: This bill would overhaul the City's Third Party Transfer program, which foreclosures on distressed, tax-delinquent buildings and transfers them to third parties for rehabilitation. It broadens the definition of distressed property, adds new notice requirements for owners and residents, and creates new ways for owners to avoid losing their property. It also repeals existing sections on installment payment agreements for delinquent taxes and charges.
